summary: Plaintiff first raised fees in its opening public term sheet, and fee amounts were negotiated alongside class relief before the final settlement was reached. The transcript links fees and class relief through total-outlay reasoning, but there is no clear evidence that class counsel prioritized its own compensation, that defense exploited fee interest, or that any reverse auction occurred. The court declaration does not falsely state that fees were negotiated only after class relief was agreed.
